_what: Grammars that are carried in this repository rather than installed. One file, one reason, and the reason is written down: the Dart grammar is published only inside a package whose install script compiles a native binding it does not ship a prebuild for, so `npm i` fails on any machine without Python and a C++ toolchain. An optional dependency would have installed cleanly and left Dart quietly unavailable, which is the defect this tool reports in other people's code.
_theCost: Every user of npx pays for what is in the package, including the ones who never open a Dart file. 1.07 MB is the price of the language, paid once per install rather than 23.9 MB of a seventeen-grammar collection paid by everyone.
_howToCheck: test/vocabulary.mjs hashes the file and refuses to go on if it is not the one recorded here, then loads it and parses a fixture. A swapped or truncated grammar fails there rather than at the first scan of somebody's project.

grammars.licence: MIT, kept beside the file as tree-sitter-dart.LICENSE
grammars.whyNotTheDependency: tree-sitter-dart-orchard@0.7.0 declares `install: node-gyp-build` and ships no prebuilds, so installing it compiles from source. Measured on Windows: `gyp ERR! Could not find any Python installation to use`. Only the .wasm is used; the native binding never is.
